identity_decisions.decision: Exclude unspecified generic Xylene from descriptor-dependent analyses; retain provenance and counts. No o-/m-/p-xylene constants may be assigned without isomer or product composition.
identity_decisions.reason: Isomer identity is missing. A mixture or unspecified xylene cannot be treated as one pure isomer.

identity_decisions.decision: DOWANOL PMA CAS108-65-6 major isomer provides conventional representative values; retain label and source-grade caveat.
identity_decisions.reason: The primary TDS explicitly draws the major isomer CH3OCH2CH(CH3)OAc; it does not establish that every experimental record is chemically pure single-regioisomer material. Do not map beta isomer CAS70657-70-4 or other glycol acetates to the same identity.

limitations: Primary indexed Fisher viscosity and DMC SDS could not be downloaded; their exact numeric/temperature evidence is cached from web tool. Neither is falsely described as a locally inspected PDF.

OECD exact isobutanol viscosity omits temperature; temperature is crosschecked through the primary measurement paper Table1, available in web index. Original handbook page201 was not directly inspected.
NMP density cross-source discrepancy remains explicit: adopting rounded manufacturer1.03@25C does not prove that CRC84 1.0230 is a printing error.
Manufacturer/supplier typical property values lack quantitative experimental uncertainties and lot-specific guarantees; extra displayed digits do not constitute measured precision.
